artworks.title: A Farmer and a Sheep Crossing a Rustic Bridge
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene from an elevated point of view. The horizon is depicted by a faint line of distant trees and hills merging with the sky. In the center, a figure is riding an animal across a rustic bridge over a stream. Tall trees frame the scene, with delicate branches reaching upwards in a canopy. Birds are faintly visible in the sky. The brushstroke style is intricate and delicate, with fine lines composing the trees and foliage. The color palette is monochromatic, dominated by sepia tones.

artworks.title: Edgar Degas
artworks.medium: graphite on paperboard
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a side view sketch, standing with hands clasped behind his back, holding a piece of fabric. He has a beard, mustache, and medium-length hair, wearing a jacket and trousers. A detailed top hat is placed on a stool to his left. Another figure with a top hat and cane is seen behind, looking at framed artwork on a wall. The background is neutral, resembling a simple room or gallery with art and furniture.

artworks.title: Dance in the Country
artworks.medium: pen and brush and gray ink on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on brown wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: This drawing depicts a man from the waist up, seated in a forward-facing position. The man has prominent facial features, including a strong nose and thick eyebrows. His hair is medium in length and slightly wavy, with a full beard and mustache. He is wearing a jacket over a shirt. The drawing is done in ink on a brown-toned paper. The background is plain. The artwork is framed by a simple outline, and there's a signature in the lower right corner of the drawing, with the name "H. Rousseau" inscribed below the image on the paper.

artworks.title: Rue de Rivoli and Pavillon Marsan
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows a street scene of a town square with various classic European buildings, trees, and people in period clothing engaged in activities. A grand building with steep, dark roof and chimneys stands out on the horizon. The painting is detailed with precise brushstrokes and features a warm color palette of ochres, blues, and greens.

artworks.title: Mary Cassatt at the Louvre: The Etruscan Gallery
artworks.medium: soft-ground etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals. The person on the left is seated and holding a book. They wear an overcoat and a necklace. The person on the right stands with an umbrella in their right hand. They have curly hair and wear a fitted jacket with a long skirt. Both figures wear formal attire. The background is simple.

artworks.title: Virginie Being Admired While the Marquis Cavalcanti Looks On
artworks.medium: monotype (black ink) touched with pastel on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon

artworks.title: Self-Portrait at Seventeen
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper; laid down
artworks.dimensions:
image: 15.6 x 12.6 cm (6 1/8 x 4 15/16 in.)
plate (lithograph stone): 22.3 x 15.9 cm (8 3/4 x 6 1/4 in.)
sheet: 34.6 x 27.7 cm (13 5/8 x 10 7/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows a head and shoulders portrait of a person. The individual is mostly in profile with their head turned slightly towards the viewer. The facial features include a strong nose, distinct lips, and a highlighted broad forehead. The hair is brushed back and covers the ears partially. The person wears a dark, high-collared garment. The background is a textured, dark surface, contrasting with the lighter portions of the face. The style of the image is reminiscent of pointillism, with intricate dot patterns creating shading and form.

artworks.title: Child with Sword, Turned to the Left (L'Enfant à l'épée, tourné à gauche)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint in black on japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows a young boy standing with a slight turn in his posture. He has wide-open eyes, a small mouth, short, neatly styled hair, and is dressed in a formal outfit consisting of a dark jacket, knee-length pants, dark shoes, a large white collar, and a sash around his neck and body. He is holding a stick or cane with one hand. The background is plain with shaded areas and textured lines suggesting a subtle pattern or shadowing effect.

artworks.title: Berthe Morisot
artworks.medium: lithograph on chine collé on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows a bust portrait of a woman. She is depicted facing slightly to the right with her head turned towards the viewer. She has dark eyes, softly drawn facial features, and dark hair styled loosely. She wears a large hat with a bow or ribbon, a dark outfit with a high collar, and possibly layers of clothing. The background is plain and light, emphasizing the subject.

artworks.title: Fashionable People at Les Ambassadeurs (Aux Ambassadeurs: Gens Chic)
artworks.medium: oil à l'essence over black chalk on wove paper, mounted on cardboard
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: A man and woman sit across from each other at a small, narrow café table under a porch-like roof in this vertical drawing on tan paper. The people’s skin is the color of the paper, and their clothing and hints of the surrounding are painted with streaks and thin washes of vivid color. Closer to us and to the left, the woman sits in a chair with an arched back. Her face is mostly angled away from us, but she has a delicate nose, and her lips appear to be closed. Her pale turquoise-blue dress has a high neck, a tight bodice, a long skirt, and long sleeves puffed along the upper arm. A black hat with short sprays like a spurting fountain is tucked into her yellow updo. Across from her, the man also has yellow hair. His eyes are almost slits under thin brows, and his small lips are closed and possibly pursed under a thin mustache. He has a square chin and prominent jawline. He wears a black tie and dinner jacket with a white flower tucked into the buttonhole. His shirt and the tablecloth are the tan of the paper. A decanter of a yellow liquid, presumably wine, sits on the table. A gray fenced at elbow height for the seated couple runs across the back of the space. The view under the overhanging roof is cobalt blue with tree canopies shaded turquoise green. A store window across a black street shows a mannequin wearing a pink dress. The scene is loosely sketched and details fade beyond the main couple. The artist signed the lower left corner with his initials, HTL, conjoined in a circle.

artworks.title: Victor-Auguste de Saint-Rémy
artworks.medium: graphite heightened with white chalk on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: This image is a charcoal drawing of a seated man from the waist up. He is slightly angled to the right but looks straight ahead, with facial features including a nose, lips, and eyes. He has short, windswept hair and wears a suit with a jacket, waistcoat, and cravat. His hands are resting in his lap. The background is plain, and there is a faint inscription to the left of the man.

artworks.title: Souvenir of Tuscany
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The drawing portrays a landscape as viewed from the edge of a path or clearing. The scene shows trees, a small settlement, and a distant view beyond. The horizon is in the middle with hills and clouds in the background. The trees are drawn with fine pencil strokes, from detailed branches up close to a soft, ethereal look further away. A few buildings are visible on gently rolling land. The color palette is only shades of gray, enhancing the pencil shading and lines.

artworks.title: An Antique Sculpture of a Horse
artworks.medium: graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a rearing horse. The drawing captures a horse in an energetic pose, with its front legs raised. The sketch is rendered on aged, slightly stained paper, with careful attention paid to the contours of the horse's body, its musculature, and the fluid motion of its tail. Delicate shading gives the drawing depth and a sense of three-dimensionality. French text is written alongside the horse.

artworks.title: Two Tahitians Gathering Fruit [recto]
artworks.medium: traced monotype, printed twice, in brown and ocher on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals from the midsection upwards. One person faces forward, while the other has their back turned towards the viewer, both appearing to be engaged in an activity reaching or holding something above them. The person facing forward has their head slightly tilted, with prominent cheekbones and a serene expression. Their hair is long and flows past their shoulders. The other individual has long, dark hair cascading over their back. Both individuals seem to be wearing minimal clothing with loose fabric covering their bodies. The first person is wearing a circular earring in one ear. The background is abstract with textured, earthy tones, framing the figures without any distinct scenery.

artworks.title: Two Tahitians Gathering Fruit [verso]
artworks.medium: graphite and blue colored pencil on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: In this drawing, we see the upper bodies of two individuals. The person on the left is shown from the back, with their head turned slightly to the left, reaching upwards with one arm, grasping a branch with leaves and fruit. Their hair is of medium length and appears wavy, draped down the nape of the neck. The individual is wearing a draped garment that exposes the back and shoulder. Their arm has a band with a pattern. The person on the right is nearly in profile, facing the viewer, with long straight hair tucked behind the ear, where a circular earring is visible. The person also wears a draped garment, and their face is calm and focused. Both individuals are surrounded by stylized leaves and fruit, creating an organic and naturalistic background. The overall background is light with subtle shades, which allows the figures and the foliage to stand out prominently.

artworks.title: Head of a Man [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over traces of graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image is a detailed sketch of a man's head and upper shoulders. The man is in profile facing left with his head slightly turned upward. He has a prominent nose and mustache, deep-set eyes, and short, curly hair styled in a tousled yet controlled manner. The sketch emphasizes the texture and movement of his hair through intricate line work. He appears shirtless with no visible clothing on his shoulders or upper chest, and there are no visible jewelry or objects. The drawing has a simple background with shaded areas for depth, against a plain, lightly textured backdrop.

artworks.title: Study of a Man [verso]
artworks.medium: black chalk with stumping on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a man's head and shoulders facing towards the left. His facial features are visible, such as deep-set eyes, a straight nose, and a defined jawline. He has short, slightly wavy hair. The man appears to be wearing a draped garment with soft, rounded folds near his shoulders. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The background is a plain, lightly shaded surface with sketched lines and markings, giving an unfinished appearance.

artworks.title: Bottles and Bowl
artworks.medium: graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of three tall bottles and a bowl. The color palette is simple, with various shades of grey and black against a white background. The bottles are arranged in a cluster, with two bottles almost parallel on the left side and the third slightly to the right. The bowl is in front of the bottles, placed on a flat surface near the bottom of the composition.

artworks.title: The Queen
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring horses and tents. The composition includes a collection of tents with pointed roofs in the background. In the center, a horse is displayed with an ornate saddle blanket. The horse is alongside a group of people, some in military attire with plumed hats. To the left, two figures in long gowns are walking near the tents. The sky has light clouds, suggesting an overcast day or early morning. The drawing captures a scene involving equestrians.

artworks.title: Officers and Courtesans in an Interior
artworks.medium: pen and brush and brown ink with watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman standing with her back slightly turned towards the viewer, looking to her left with her hands on her hips. She has dark hair styled in a bun and wears a long dress with a fitted bodice, a wide skirt, and a blue sash or decoration at the waist. Dangling earrings are visible. The scene is set in an indoor gathering place, with several people seated or standing around tables. The background shows more figures conversing, with hanging lamps illuminating the area.

artworks.title: Dr. Louis Martinet
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: This drawing depicts a man's upper body. The man is slightly turned to the left, but he is looking at us. He has high cheekbones, deep-set eyes, a large nose, and arched eyebrows. His short hair is slightly tousled. He is wearing a high-collared shirt, a cravat or necktie, and a heavy jacket. The background is plain, off-white paper, and below the drawing is a line of text.

artworks.title: Henri Labrouste
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a man seated in a chair. He is facing slightly to the side, with his hand supporting his head. The man has distinct facial features, including deep-set eyes and a high forehead, with short, possibly combed back hair. He is dressed in a suit with a tie or scarf, and a coat with vertical seams. The chair has patterned upholstery. The background is plain, emphasizing the portrait's subject.
